Before you make your move

Your actual selling price can differ from the listed price. Enter the value shown in your official team for a more useful budget estimate.

We add this swap to transfers already made, subtract your free quota, and charge 4 points for each extra move. The summary shows both total gameweek cost and the additional cost of this swap.

No. This is an independent planning tool. Your plans stay in your browser and you must make any real changes on the official fantasy platform.
